typography.font_strategy: The 'Command Center Mono' strategy. All monospace as explicitly requested by the user, styled heavily to feel like a high-end sports broadcast graphic rather than a code editor.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. Dense, highly functional, modular bento boxes. No wasted space.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment for stats; center alignment strictly for the Wagon Wheel SVG.

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). 1px solid borders `border-border/50`, dark flat backgrounds `bg-[#0A0A0A]`, with selective glowing linear borders (Tracing Beam) for the active session state.
surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70` with a sharp 1px `border-b border-white/10`.
surface_strategies.panels: Deep black `#000000` to ensure high contrast against the neon data visualizations.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp, fast transitions. `hover:bg-white/5`, subtle 1px border highlights.
interactions_and_motion.active_states: Bright neon green glowing borders or background tints for active selections (e.g., active shot type toggle).
interactions_and_motion.animations: Subtle entry fades. Shot lines on the Wagon Wheel should use framer-motion path drawing (`stroke-dasharray` animation) when a shot is logged.

components.stats_dashboard: Use raw Tailwind CSS grids for modular tiles. Use `tabular-nums` for live data to avoid layout shifting. Glowing green text for active metrics like Strike Rate.
components.wagon_wheel_svg: HTML/SVG hybrid. Pitch in the center, dashed 30-yard circle, labels for field positions (Fine Leg, Square Leg, Mid Wicket, Mid On, Mid Off, Cover, Point, Third Man, Straight). LH/RH toggle flips the labels along the Y-axis.
components.shot_logger: Shadcn-based buttons configured for tactical monochrome with neon active states. Grid layout for runs (0,1,2,3,4,6) strictly matching the color code.
components.charts: Shadcn/Recharts for the Run Distribution bar chart. Bars must be colored exactly according to the `wagon_wheel` run color palette.
components.coaching_panel: AI chat style interface. Distinct dark green tint `bg-[#051A0C]` for AI responses to separate them from user logs.
components.live_camera_video: UI shell only. 16:9 aspect ratio black placeholder `bg-black` with a subtle camera icon, recording red dot, and a 'coming soon' overlay.
components.stripe_pricing: 3-tier bento layout (Free, Pro, Academy). The Academy tier is highlighted with the glowing 'Tracing Beam' border.

icons_and_assets.style: Crisp, solid lines, typically 1.5x stroke width.

image_urls.description: Darkened, moody background of batsman for the auth or landing screen. Use heavy black gradient overlay (bg-black/80).
Stadium lights at night. Use as a highly blurred backdrop for the subscription tier or profile page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid Fullstack PWA using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Strictly follow the color codes for the run values (0=grey,1=cyan,2=green,3=yellow,4=orange,6=purple) across the logger, wagon wheel, and charts.

Implement the Wagon Wheel as a responsive SVG. The pitch is in the center. Map shot paths radiating outwards: Drive -> Straight/Mid Off/Mid On, Pull -> Mid Wicket/Square Leg, Cut -> Point, Sweep -> Fine Leg/Square Leg, Flick -> Mid Wicket/Fine Leg, Defend -> short lines straight back.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to EVERY button, input, and interactive element.
Mobile-first is critical. The dashboard tiles, shot logger, and wagon wheel must stack perfectly on mobile phones without horizontal scrolling.
Implement Shadcn Tabs component for switching between 'Dashboard', 'History', and 'Coach' views.

Since standard Shadcn fonts like Inter are strictly forbidden here, ensure `JetBrains Mono` and `Space Mono` (or standard monospace) are applied to the `tailwind.config.js` and `index.css` global files.
PWA support requires standard web app manifest and service worker configuration in the public folder.
